svg.title: Layout of one SignalWays frame
svg.desc: Amplitudes reshaped to six rows of 320 samples, one per signal way of a three-mount, two-channel-id sensor; the row index is the receiving mount index times two plus the channel id. Beside the grid the five per-signal-way channels hold one entry per row, and only the VALID bit of Flags separates a silent row from one that received an echo. Axes under the grid convert the sample index to range, and a strip below shows the flat storage order.
svg.text: Amplitudes, reshaped: one row per signal way, 320 samples each
a three-mount sensor whose firing sequences use channel ids 0 and 1: 3 × 2 = 6 signal ways
bin lower bound at sampleDuration = 102.4 us:
about 1.8 cm per sample; the 320 samples reach about 5.6 m
sample s of signal way w is entry w × numSamplesPerSignalWay + s
VALID (0x40): this signal way received an echo
Flags 0: silent, though its ids read 0, 0, 0, 0 too
